verdict.rationale: Cekura accepts custom metadata with each ingested call log (cekura-docs-6/25), and its dashboards can visualize and analyze call data and metadata (cekura-docs-11). That allows some usage slicing by call/session attributes, but nothing shows cost tracking or attribution of spend to users or features. Missing for 10: any cost capture or cost reporting, explicit per-user and per-feature attribution, documentation of grouping or aggregation by metadata keys, and independent corroboration.
